integrity: The sharp best constant and Landau example are credited to arXiv:2610.19010v1. Strict inverse positivity, the full exact two-part defect and all complex equality cases are the assessed contribution. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: All positive integer orders and finite lengths with zero-extension backward differences; no uniform dimension-independent stability constant, no extension to other boundary conditions. Priority risk from classical inverse-positive polyharmonic kernels.
title: Strict polyharmonic Green positivity and an exact phase–shape Sobolev deficit
